probes.title: Revenue $lookup sub-pipeline plus $facet by_tier by_month largest
probes.behavior: revenue report joins orders to customers via $lookup let/pipeline + $unwind and returns by_tier, by_month and largest in one $facet; cancelled and out-of-range orders excluded, double totals converted to cents

probes.title: Lookup with localField plus pipeline filter and group
probes.behavior: products join inventory via $lookup with localField/foreignField plus pipeline $expr $lt filter, then $match stock.0 $exists and $group by category with $sort

probes.title: Facet largest top-5 with lookup tier
probes.behavior: revenue largest facet returns 5 largest orders sorted by total_cents desc with tier from $lookup sub-pipeline, exercising $sort $limit $project inside $facet and double-to-cents conversion

probes.title: Running total and sequence via $setWindowFields
probes.behavior: Customer timeline running_total with documents unbounded to current and order_seq with $documentNumber partitioned by customer_id ordered by placed_at; cancelled and other-customer docs must be excluded by $match

probes.title: 90-day rolling sum via range window
probes.behavior: Customer timeline 90-day rolling sum with $sum range [-90,current] unit day partitioned by customer ordered by placed_at; includes double total conversion via $cond $type $round

probes.title: Previous order date via $shift
probes.behavior: Customer timeline previous order date with $shift by -1 partitioned by customer ordered by placed_at; first order must yield null

probes.title: Filtered positional refund targets only requested lines
probes.behavior: mark only the requested order lines as refunded with a filtered positional update guarded by line_id list and refund_status none

probes.title: Filtered positional guard skips already-refunded lines
probes.behavior: filtered positional guard on refund_status none prevents re-refunding an already refunded line

probes.title: All-positional marks every line reviewed
probes.behavior: mark every order line as reviewed in a single update using the all-positional $[] operator

probes.title: Abort rolls back multi-line reservations and order
probes.behavior: checkout must atomically reserve inventory for all lines, insert the order, and convert the cart in one transaction, rolling back all reservations if any line is out of stock or the order insert fails

probes.title: Commit atomically persists reservations order and cart
probes.behavior: checkout must atomically reserve inventory for all lines, insert the order, and convert the cart in one transaction, persisting all three only on commit

probes.title: Uncommitted reservation invisible outside transaction
probes.behavior: uncommitted checkout reservation must not be visible outside the transaction but must be visible inside, and abort must restore the original stock

probes.title: Change stream filtered to update and replace only
probes.behavior: Change stream with $match filter to update/replace only delivers updates and replaces while suppressing inserts

probes.title: Change stream fullDocument updateLookup on update
probes.behavior: Change stream with fullDocument updateLookup returns the post-update document for update operations

probes.title: Change stream one event per change with non-blocking poll
probes.behavior: Change stream with non-blocking polling emits one event per update in order without loss and empty poll returns promptly

probes.title: Case-insensitive email lookup with collation
probes.behavior: customer lookup by email must match case-insensitively using collation strength 2

probes.title: Case-insensitive unique email via collation index
probes.behavior: customer email uniqueness is case-insensitive via collation index locale en strength 2

probes.title: Collation controls case sensitivity of email match
probes.behavior: email match without collation is case-sensitive and with collation strength 2 is case-insensitive

probes.title: Partial unique allows missing coupon but rejects duplicate per customer
probes.behavior: coupon_code uniqueness per customer is enforced only when coupon_code exists via partial unique index

probes.title: Partial unique coupon allows same code for different customers
probes.behavior: coupon_code uniqueness is per customer, same coupon_code for different customers is allowed

probes.title: TTL expires only active carts at expires_at
probes.behavior: active carts auto-delete at expires_at via TTL index limited to status active

probes.title: $jsonSchema requires customer_id, status, items, total and placed_at on orders
probes.behavior: orders enforces $jsonSchema with required customer_id, status, items, total, placed_at at level moderate; inserts missing a required field fail with 121 and only valid docs persist

probes.title: $jsonSchema enum and minimum on orders status and total
probes.behavior: orders $jsonSchema restricts status to pending/paid/shipped/cancelled and total to >=0; violating inserts fail with 121 and only valid doc persists

probes.title: $jsonSchema bsonType on items and placed_at plus update validation on orders
probes.behavior: orders $jsonSchema requires items as array and placed_at as date and validates updates to valid docs; violating inserts and updates fail with 121 while valid update succeeds

probes.title: Text search weighted ranking with active filter
probes.behavior: Active product keyword search uses $text with weighted text index (name:10, tags:5, description:1) and $meta textScore ranking; higher-weight field matches must rank first and inactive products must be filtered.

probes.title: Text search exclusion term with active filter
probes.behavior: Product search supports $text exclusion terms (e.g. premium -jacket) combined with active:true filter and textScore sort; excluded-term documents must not match.

probes.title: Text search active products ranked by textScore
probes.behavior: Keyword product search uses $text index over name, description and tags with weights and returns only active products sorted by textScore ranking.

probes.title: Cart upsert fetch convert conditional delete
probes.behavior: Touching a cart must upsert by _id marking active, fetching uses find by customer_id+status, converting updates status/order_id by _id, discarding deletes only when still active

probes.title: Order compare-and-set with history and filtered finds
probes.behavior: Order status must compare-and-set on _id+status $in while $set status/updated_at and $push history with no modification on stale prior set, history uses find by customer_id with projection sort limit, open orders uses find by status with sort limit and count

probes.title: Referral chain via $graphLookup with depth tracking
probes.behavior: referral chain report recursively follows referred_by to _id in customers and collects ancestors as referrers with depth tracking
